Contact: collab@saltmarsh.example.com is officially published, with a mailbox verified by the runtime check (not catch-all), so policy readiness is ELIGIBLE_FOR_GATES / READY_FOR_GATES; this is not send authorization. Only two materially different, brand-grounded collaboration ideas are supported by the evidence, so I did not pad to the usual three. Open unknowns: exact Library routes, whether Saltmarsh does creator collaborations, sourcing and sustainability practices, and whether the Library is still running (last observed 2026-06-02).
